mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_orders ( ql_id, username, total_price, order_name, order_phone, shipping_zipcode, shipping_address1, shipping_address2, receiver_name, receiver_phone, shipping_memo, order_status, order_date ) VALUES ( #{qlId}, #{username}, #{totalPrice}, #{orderName}, #{orderPhone}, #{shippingZipcode}, #{shippingAddress1}, #{shippingAddress2}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{shippingMemo}, #{orderStatus}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO tbl_order_items ( ql_id, product_id, amount, item_price ) VALUES ( #{qlId}, #{productId}, #{amount}, #{itemPrice} )
INSERT INTO tbl_order_item_options ( order_item_id, option_name, option_price, quantity ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{optionName}, #{optionPrice}, #{quantity} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.cart_item_id FROM tbl_orders o JOIN tbl_order_items oi ON o.ql_id = oi.ql_id JOIN tbl_cart c ON oi.product_id = c.product_id WHERE o.ql_id = #{qlId}

SELECT o.order_id as orderId, o.ql_id as qlId, o.payment_key as paymentKey, o.username, o.total_price as totalPrice, o.order_name as orderName, o.order_phone as orderPhone, o.shipping_zipcode as shippingZipcode, o.shipping_address1 as shippingAddress1, o.shipping_address2 as shippingAddress2, o.shipping_extra_address as shippingExtraAddress, o.shipping_memo as shippingMemo, o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone, o.order_status as orderStatus, o.order_date as orderDate, ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'orderItemId', oi.order_item_id, 'qlId', oi.ql_id, 'productId', oi.product_id, 'productName', p.name, 'manufacturer', p.manufacturer, 'imageUrl', p.image_url, 'amount', oi.amount, 'itemPrice', oi.item_price, 'options', ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'optionId', oio.option_id, 'orderItemId', oio.order_item_id, 'optionName', oio.option_name, 'optionPrice', oio.option_price, 'quantity', oio.quantity ) ) FROM tbl_order_item_options oio WHERE oio.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id ) ) ) FROM tbl_order_items oi JOIN tbl_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id /* 추가: products 테이블 조인 */ WHERE oi.ql_id = o.ql_id ) as orderItems FROM tbl_orders o WHERE o.ql_id = #{qlId}

SELECT o.order_id as orderId, o.ql_id as qlId, o.payment_key as paymentKey, o.username, o.total_price as totalPrice, o.order_name as orderName, o.order_status as orderStatus, o.order_date as orderDate, ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'orderItemId', oi.order_item_id, 'productId', oi.product_id, 'productName', p.name, 'manufacturer', p.manufacturer, 'imageUrl', p.image_url, 'amount', oi.amount, 'itemPrice', oi.item_price ) ) FROM tbl_order_items oi JOIN tbl_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.ql_id = o.ql_id ) as orderItems FROM tbl_orders o WHERE o.username = #{username} ORDER BY o.order_date DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_orders SET payment_key = #{paymentKey}, order_status = 'PAID' WHERE ql_id = #{qlId}
